mapper.sql: select n.*, u.nickname, u.level_image from notice n left join user u on n.user_idx = u.idx
mapper.select: order by n.written_date desc, n.idx desc
where n.type = 0 or n.type = #{type} order by n.written_date desc, n.idx desc
mapper.insert: insert into notice (user_idx, type, title, content) values (#{userIdx}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.update: update notice set type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, modify_date = now() where idx = #{idx}
update notice set hits = hits + 1 where idx = #{idx}
